source.title: ProspectMate: source code for Dragon Isles prospecting/milling tracking and persisted aggregates
source.author: Urutseg

notes: New source-code/export feasibility audit after exhausting original sampled cohorts: tracked Dragon Isles Prospecting spell 374627 and Milling 382981 (legacy). In source, CommitSession() stores SmartProspectorDB.reagents[inputID].consumed from observed before/after item-count deltas and sums results[outputID] quantity; no persisted total casts, per-output castsWithDrop, 0/1/2+ histogram, ingredient rank or profession skill/stat/build. A published player database would be at most a reference for net input and output totals and could not be converted into measured per-cast probabilities. NO shared saved-variable data was found; no rates/denominators/zeros derived. Existing named firsthand Reddit and Wowhead cohorts were recognized as duplicates, not added. The source alone is NOT a Dragonflight numerical study.
lookingFor: Original public Dragonflight ProspectMate/SavedVariables or other player-collected processing event ledger, including rank-separated Draconium Ore 189143/188658/190311, Serevite Ore 190395/190396/190394, Khaz'gorite Ore 190312/190313/190314, Prismatic Ore 194545, Bubble Poppy 191467, Saxifrage 191464/191465/191466, exact output item IDs, completed casts, Resourcefulness refunds, per-output hit/zero counts and histograms.
whereLooked: CurseForge official ProspectMate listing (https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/prospectmate): names Dragonflight-era older recipes as trackable, but displays no player sample, casts or material yield table.

GitHub Urutseg/ProspectMate ProspectMate.lua (https://github.com/Urutseg/ProspectMate/blob/main/ProspectMate.lua): searched Dragon Isles Prospecting / Milling spells and actual SmartProspectorDB schema. DB stores per-reagent net consumed and cumulative per-output quantity; no persisted completed-cast counter, output-specific hit count, zero bin or event histogram.

GitHub Urutseg/ProspectMate README.MD and public issue/file listings (https://github.com/Urutseg/ProspectMate): no publicly committed saved-variable specimen or numerical study, only source code and development PR.

GitHub cross-repository code search: 'SmartProspectorDB' and 'ProspectMateDB' sample tables; only addon implementation surfaced, no independently released Dragonflight character save with Draconium Ore or Saxifrage data.

Reddit r/woweconomy name searches for 'Draconium Ore prospected data spreadsheet', 'Serevite Ore prospected gems 2023', and 'Khazgorite Ore original completed prospect output' resurfaced historical original Jallfo, Bugy, Ursallena, ar_rules and 10i63zb cohorts already in research, not a new cohort (https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/zez5sj).

Reddit r/woweconomy name searches 'Bubble Poppy milled 1000 pigment' and 'Saxifrage milled Blazing Pigment 100' exposed old Aary result on Wowhead (https://www.wowhead.com/item=198418/blazing-pigment); previously indexed author, without original per-mill 0-N histogram.

Wowhead named Dragon Isles Prospecting spell original Bugy table (https://www.wowhead.com/spell=374627/dragon-isles-prospecting): published per-ore averages and nominal ore quantities, prior indexed original, not material hit histograms or refunded completed casts.
Blizzard US/EU forum name searches for Draconium Ore prospecting completed casts and Saxifrage milling outcome counts: no new original event-series surfaced.
Warcraft Wiki named Prismatic Ore original item identity page (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Prismatic_Ore): describes unlock/use rather than measured prospect output operations.

GitHub general public search for 'Saxifrage Blazing Pigment milling casts', 'Dragon Isles Milling pigment output sample' and 'Draconium Ore prospecting results': no source-original publicly committed input/output operation log.
